"Very'' well.|Asajj Ventress and Latts Razzi, on bounty hunting|{{TCW|Bounty (episode)}}}} '''Latts Razzi''' was a [[Gender|female]] [[Theelin]] [[bounty hunter]] who operated during the [[Clone Wars]]. She occasionally worked as part of a syndicate of bounty hunters known as the [[Krayt's Claw]] that included [[Boba Fett]], [[Bossk'wassak'Cradossk|Bossk]], [[Oked]], [[C-21 Highsinger]], and [[Dengar]]. During her career, she also worked with bounty hunters such as [[Sugi (bounty hunter)|Sugi]], [[Embo]], and others. After meeting the former [[Sith]] [[assassin]] [[Asajj Ventress]], Razzi and the Krayt's Claw worked two jobs with her, including a job on [[Quarzite]], and later on [[Serenno]] when Ventress hired their crew to attack [[Count of Serenno|Count]] [[Castle Serenno|Dooku's palace]]. After the Clone Wars, Razzi left the group and continued working jobs, eventually forming her own [[Razzi Syndicate|syndicate]]. ==Biography== ===The Clone Wars=== ====Job on Quarzite==== During the [[Clone Wars]], Latts Razzi worked as a [[bounty hunter]] in a team of hunters known as the [[Krayt's Claw]]. At one point, the group was hired by [[Major]] [[Rigosso]] for a job on [[Quarzite]] that required six hunters. Before they made their way to Quarzite, Razzi her fellow partners [[Bossk'wassak'Cradossk|Bossk]] and [[Oked]] were present at a [[Chalmun's Spaceport Cantina|cantina]] in [[Mos Eisley]] on [[Tatooine]]. Oked approached [[Asajj Ventress]] at the bar and flirted with her, which ultimately led to his [[death]]. After witnessing their partner die, the two hunters called Ventress over to their table to tell her that she owed them a favor after killing one of their crew. Although Ventress initially sneered at the notion, Razzi and Bossk informed her that they would turn her over to the authorities if she did not agree to fill in for Oked on their upcoming mission. Thus, the two hunters took Ventress to meet their leader, [[Boba Fett]]. When Ventress insulted Fett's stature and experience as a leader, Razzi and Bossk advanced on her to remind her that they could settle her debt to them another way, causing Ventress to back off. Fett's team then traveled to Quarzite in Bossk's [[Starship|ship]], ''[[Hound's Tooth]]''. [[File:RazziVsSodi-Bounty.jpg|thumb|left|250px|Razzi engages Krismo Sodi in hand-to-hand combat.]] At a station above Quarzite, Rigosso explained that their job was to [[Safe cargo objective|protect]] a chest of unknown contents on a [[subtram]] to [[Belugan]] leader [[Otua Blank]]. While some of the other hunters were curious what was inside the chest, Razzi dismissively replied that she did not care as long as they got paid. While delivering the chest, Razzi was partnered with the [[Battle droid|combat droid]] [[C-21 Highsinger]] to stay with the chest, while Boba and Bossk guarded the engine room and Dengar and Ventress were positioned at the rear of the tram. Soon after their departure, the group was attacked by numerous [[Kage Warriors]]. Razzi fought alongside Highsinger, fending off many [[Kage]] Warriors by matching their skill in [[Unarmed combat|martial arts]] and using her [[grappling boa]]s to great effect. Soon, she and Highsinger were attacked by the Kage leader [[Krismo Sodi]]. After hand-to-hand fight, Razzi pulled out her grappling boas again, swinging them at Sodi. However, the Kage ducked, and Razzi accidentally snared her partner Highsinger. Sodi then shoved Highsinger backwards, causing the pair to fall off of the tram.{{SWE|groups|kagewarriors|Kage Warriors}} [[File:Latts_grappling_boa.png|thumb|right|250px|Razzi used her grappling boa on the Quarzite job.]] They later regrouped at the ''Hound's Tooth'', where Ventress appeared to give them their share of the bounty. Razzi commented on the pivotal role she played as part of the team, to which Ventress replied that she was not part of the team at all. Nonetheless, Razzi, Ventress, and the crew made their way back to Mos Eisley, where Razzi and Ventress drank and talked. Razzi commented that Ventress seemed on edge, as Ventress jumped when other patrons entered the cantina, and Ventress replied that she sensed a monster from her past.{{TCW|Brothers (episode)}} ====Protecting the Hutts==== [[File:BountyHunterTableDance-Eminence.png|thumb|left|250px|Razzi prepares to defend her employers.]] Razzi did not limit her bounty hunting career by sticking solely with Krayt's Claw, however. In [[19 BBY]],''[[Star Wars: Galactic Atlas]]'' she was present on [[Nal Hutta]] acting as a bodyguard for the [[Grand Hutt Council]], working alongside [[Sugi (bounty hunter)|Sugi]] and fellow Krayt's Claw members [[Embo]] and Dengar, when the renegade [[Sith Lord]] [[Maul]], his brother [[Savage Opress]], and [[Pre Vizsla]] arrived to try and convince the Hutts to join their burgeoning [[Shadow Collective|criminal alliance]]. When negotiations turned sour, the Hutts summoned their bounty hunter protectors to kill the intruders. Despite her accuracy and skilled use of an [[X-8 Night Sniper]] blaster, Razzi was unable to land a shot on the trio and was briefly knocked down when Maul hurled a [[Twi'lek]] thug at her. The bounty hunters, backed by additional Hutt enforcers, pursued the three out of the palace and onto the landing platform, but the tide turned against them when a number of [[jetpack]]-equipped [[Mandalorian]] warriors arrived and fired [[missile]]s into their ranks. Razzi brought down one warrior with her grappling boa before advising a retreat back inside the palace. She and Dengar hung back as Sugi and Embo engaged the enemy, but when it was clear they were going to lose, she had Dengar throw in [[Smoke grenade|smoke bombs]] and shouted for her companions to flee. Maul let them go since they had no allegiance as bounty hunters. ====Reunited with Ventress==== Razzi and the rest of the syndicate members were present in a [[Unidentified bar (Level 1313)|bar]] on [[Coruscant]]'s [[Level 1313]] when the undercover [[Jedi Master]] [[Quinlan Vos]] visited asking for information on how to find Asajj Ventress, a bounty hunter who had once been [[Count]] [[Dooku]]'s [[Sith apprentice]]. Vos had been assigned by the [[Jedi High Council]] to assassinate Count Dooku and had decided to enlist Ventress as his partner. When Fett claimed that Ventress had cheated him, Latts pointed out that she had not cheated them and that they had been paid, but not in a way that pleased Fett. Fett reluctantly revealed that Ventress was [[Capture of Moregi|pursuing]] a [[Volpai]] fugitive named [[Moregi]] on [[Pantora]]. [[File:Krayts_Claw_SaV.png|thumb|right|250px|Razzi occasionally worked as a part of Krayt's Claw.]] Later, Razzi and the rest of Fett's syndicate were in the Mos Eisley Cantina when Ventress came in to enlist their help for a mission to rescue Vos, who had been [[Mission to Raxus Secundus|captured]] by Dooku and imprisoned on [[Serenno]]. Latts and her fellow hunters accepted the job after Ventress offered to pay them 250,000 [[Galactic Credit Standard|credits]] immediately. Razzi along with Fett, Ventress, Bossk, and Highsinger [[Mission to Serenno (Krayt's Claw)|traveled to Serenno]] in Fett's ship, ''[[Slave I]]''. While the bounty hunters created a distraction by attacking [[Confederacy of Independent Systems|Separatist]] [[droid]]s and [[shuttle]]s, Ventress infiltrated Dooku's [[Castle Serenno|palace]] and located Vos. However, he had turned against Ventress after learning that she had [[Battle of unidentified planet (Tholme and Ventress)|murdered]] his former Master [[Tholme]]. While Razzi and her colleagues trapped Dooku under a webbing, they were forced to escape off world with Ventress when Vos spurned their rescue effort and openly sided with Dooku. ===Imperial Era=== ====An old ally==== During the [[Imperial Era|reign]] of the [[Galactic Empire]], Razzi and C-21 Highsinger continued to work as partners. The two had taken a job hunting down a [[Unidentified four-armed alien|target]], who had a dead-or-alive reward, when they encountered Ventress. Razzi was surprised to see her one-time ally, and even more surprised to learn that she had interest in intel surrounding the [[Hidden Path|Path]], a secret network created to help [[Jedi]] escape Imperial persecution. Ventress told her that she and her associate, [[Lyco Strata]], were hoping to score big by hunting Jedi themselves. Razzi replied that if they were in search of a big score, she had a job that she could use assistance on. After Ventress requested intel on the Path in exchange for them helping her, and Razzi agreed.{{TOTU|Friends}} [[File:Friends-EpisodeThumb.png|thumb|left|275px|Razzi and Ventress reunited for a job on Cassaro.]] Razzi outlined the plan with Ventress and Strata using a [[holoprojector]] in the hold of her [[Latts Razzi's ship|ship]], which involved stealing Imperial starship equipment from a [[Cassaro shipyard|shipyard]] on [[Cassaro]]. When Strata spoke up about what kind of security the [[Venator-class Star Destroyer|''Venator''-class Star Destroyers]] would be providing the facility, Razzi deduced that Strata had inside knowledge of Republic military operations due to being either a Jedi or a [[clone trooper]]. Guessing he was a Jedi, Razzi said that she would scramble the ship's signature to avoid such issues and asked that Strata help her with doing so in the cockpit. Leaving Ventress and Highsinger in the hold, Razzi discreetly told Strata that she knew he was a Jedi and warned him not to trust Ventress. ====Job on Cassaro==== After jumping to [[hyperspace]], Razzi flew the ship low above Cassaro's [[ocean]]s, avoiding Imperial detection and landing amongst the [[tree]]s. From there, Highsinger, Ventress, and Strata split up, with Razzi staying on the ship. When Highsinger was in position, the droid contacted Razzi, who acknowledged. As a firefight broke out between Razzi's allies and a large number of Imperial stormtroopers, Razzi swooped in with her ship, firing on the [[Low Altitude Assault Transport|Imperial gunships]] and extending the boarding ramp to extract her team. In the middle of the fighting, Strata lost the score that they were after, an Imperial shield relay unit. He attempted to recover it, but was convinced by Ventress to let it go. Ventress then relayed to Razzi over comms that the cargo was lost and that the crew needed to exfiltrate. With the operation a failure, Razzi told Highsinger that it was time to switch to plan B: hand Lyco over to the Empire. As Ventress and Strata attempted to board the ship, they were betrayed by the droid, who kidnapped the Jedi and assaulted Ventress, who was seemingly left behind. Ventress, however, had managed to maneuver her way to the ship's hatch, break inside, and quickly take down Highsinger. She then held Razzi hostage at the end of her saber, demanding Razzi hand over the intel. Razzi calmly complied, inserting a [[datacard]] into a [[datapad]], and tossed it over to Strata. Afterwards, Razzi dropped off the two Force-sensitives and then left with Highsinger. ====Syndicate operation==== {{Quote|Yeah, I know Latts. She was one of the best in the biz. Wonder what she's up to now...|[[Imara Vex]]|''[[Star Wars: Hunters]]''}} [[File:Razzi Syndicate.png|thumb|right|250px|The Razzi Syndicate]] Eventually, Razzi formed her own criminal syndicate called the [[Razzi Syndicate]]. They frequently competed with the [[Pyke Syndicate]]. [[Cynabar's InfoNet]] at one point predicted that the Pyke Syndicate would challenge the Razzi Syndicate, and the latter group would fail in defending itself. Razzi's organization obtained a copy of the ''[[Smuggler's Guide]]'' when one of her operatives, a [[Rybet]] [[thief]] nicknamed "[[Sticky Fingers]]," stole it from [[Landonis Balthazar Calrissian|Lando Calrissian]] after the [[Esoomian]] brawler [[Bumblethunk]] assaulted him. Razzi had its contents verified by the [[Adarian]] [[Twirm]], who confirmed its authenticity. Among her notes in the Guide, Razzi vowed to kill everyone at Cynabar's InfoNet once her power grew enough. Twirm made suggestions for the organization which enraged Razzi, prompting her to order Twirm's execution. Razzi's entire exchange with Twirm was recorded in the logbook. It was seized by [[Crimson Dawn]] when they conducted a [[Razzi warehouse raid|raid]] on a Razzi Syndicate warehouse. [[Qi'ra]], [[Lieutenant (criminal)|lieutenant]] to Crimson Dawn leader [[Dryden Vos]], recorded details of the stolen cargo in the logbook shortly after it was acquired in the raid. Razzi at one point became involved with the operations of [[Grakkus Jahibakti Tingi|Grakkus the Hutt]], assigned to deliver a shipment of [[Mark X Executioner droid]]s for use in his arena. The shipment, however, never arrived despite her promises. When [[Han Solo]] came across the ''Smuggler's Guide'' for a second time, he speculated that Razzi might have come to a bad end. Years later, while meeting with other former Krayt's Claw members, Boba Fett noted that none of them had ever found out what had become of Razzi.{{StoryCite|story=Wait for It|book=From a Certain Point of View: The Empire Strikes Back}} By [[9 ABY]], her ultimate fate remained unknown, with fellow bounty hunter [[Imara Vex]] wondering what had happened to her. ==Personality and traits== Latts Razzi was a [[Theelin]] [[Gender|female]] with [[Color|strawberry blonde]] [[hair]], blue [[eye]]s, and lavender skin. She stood at 1.79 [[meter]]s (5 [[Foot|feet]], 10 inches) tall. Razzi was known as a deadly mercenary and although she was known to charge a high rate for her services, many clients felt that she was worth the investment.{{Topps|set=2020 Topps Women of Star Wars|cardname=#42: Latts Razzi|link=https://www.tcdb.com/ViewCard.cfm/sid/216003/cid/14374535/2020-Topps-Women-of-Star-Wars-42-Latts-Razzi|nobackup=1}} As a result, she immersed herself in first-class comforts and expensive clothing, which she used her career to pay for. ==Skills and abilities== [[File:Grappling_Boa_AtG.png|thumb|right|250px|Razzi was skilled in the use of a grappling boa.]] Latts was highly skilled in many types of weaponry. She was an exceptional markswoman and had pinpoint accuracy with a [[blaster pistol]], as well as being an expert in several forms of exotic unarmed combat. During her job on Quarzite she showed herself capable of going head-to-head in hand-to hand combat with the leader of the Kage Warriors, Krismo Sodi. Razzi was said to charge very high rates, yet had the skill to back it up. Razzi was also a skilled martial artist and was known for her tracking and infiltration. ==Equipment== Latts' weapon of choice was a [[grappling boa]] made up of scales, which she used as a whip, a lasso and a lariat against her many opponents. She saw the weapon as stylish and practical. When not in use the grappling boa was fashionably draped around her shoulders like a [[scarf]]. During her conflict with Maul and [[Death Watch]] on Nal Hutta, she utilized an [[X-8 Night Sniper]]. ==Behind the scenes== [[File:Latts_Razzi_Concept_Art.jpg|thumb|left|220px|Character concept of Latts Razzi, as seen in ''The Clone Wars'' episode "Bounty."]] Latts Razzi first appeared in "[[Bounty (episode)|Bounty]]," the twentieth episode of the [[The Clone Wars: Season Four|fourth season]] of the television series ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars]]''. She was voiced by [[Clare Grant]], whose face was used as the template for the character's facial features.{{SW|url=series/clone-wars/bounty-episode-guide|text="Bounty" Episode Guide | The Clone Wars}} The character was created as a wedding gift for Grant, as she was a big fan of ''Star Wars'' and wanted to play a character in the series.[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars The Complete Season Four|''Star Wars: The Clone Wars'' The Complete Season Four]] The character appeared in two more episodes of ''The Clone Wars''—"[[Brothers (episode)|Brothers]]" and "[[Eminence
